name: Shipping Notices and No shipping options found info for WooCommerce
author: Octolize Shipping Plugins

sections.description:
The best free plugin to display shipping notices in your WooCommerce store

Change the “no shipping options were found” message into your custom notice with this free Shipping Notices and No shipping options found info for WooCommerce plugin.

Customers who receive the standard “no shipping options were found” message are more likely to abandon the shopping cart in your WooCommerce store. Boost sales by creating a custom message that explains the reason and makes it easy for them to change their cart contents or contact the store.

Features

  • Replace the default “No shipping found” notice with your custom text
  • Use HTML tags to build any notice you want
  • Display shipping notice only for specific regions/shipping zones
  • Decide where the notice should be displayed: cart, checkout, or both

Create even more advanced shipping notices
Use Shipping Notices together with the Flexible Shipping plugin to create advanced messages based on various conditions. Install the free version of Flexible Shipping or buy Flexible Shipping PRO.

Possible notice scenarios

  • Contact for individual shipping quote
  • Order exceeds the maximum weight allowed for shipment
  • Order exceeds the maximum size allowed for shipment
  • Shipment available from a certain order amount
  • Shipping to a certain country is not available

Actively developed and supported

Over 250.000 WooCommerce stores worldwide use our plugins. We constantly develop them, earning the reputation of authors of stable and high-quality solutions. We are also praised for providing excellent technical support. Join the community of our satisfied plugin users: bet on quality, and let our plugins do the rest.

sections.installation:
This plugin can be easily installed like any other WordPress integration by following the steps below:

  1. Download and unzip the latest zip file release.
  2. Upload the entire plugin directory to your /wp-content/plugins/ path.
  3. Activate the plugin using the Plugins menu in WordPress sidebar menu.

Optionally you can also try to upload the plugin zip file using Plugins -> Add New -> Upload Plugin option from the WordPress sidebar menu. Then go directly to point 3.
